title: Whole Split Rejoin Channel and Dry Island Terrain
description: One newly authored complete static river-terrain appearance. One upstream and one downstream cut-edge water opening are joined by two unequal-curving channels around one elongated raised dry island. Both branches separate and reconnect rather than ending as coves; outer banks remain separate from the island above the flat water-appearance level. All sloping banks, island, water-coloured flat facets and deep substrate form one shared-vertex closed terrain with a finite basal sole. Opaque matte water appearance is integral solid-filled surface, not a fluid simulation, transparent sheet or an unfilled air layer over a separate floor. Newly authored two-route geometry, not old Y confluence with added arms, nor old cutoff lake with a renamed dry neck. One terrain model zero scenes. No measured geomorphology, sediment process, current direction, flow dynamics, traversal, real habitat or safety claim; rig animation and interaction not made.
